overview.description: The Roundhill T-REX 2X Long DRAM Daily Target ETF (RAM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund seeks to track the 2x the daily performance return of the Roundhill Memory ETF, a global basket of memory stocks. RAM is a bullish leveraged bet on the share price of DRAM RAM was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Roundhill.
